_doc: Every repository Litha looks after. mode merge = she merges PRs into base when every gate and her review pass; mode review = she reviews and logs ready/hold but never merges. base * = PRs into any branch (review only). The first entry is STAR's home repo: fixer, proofs, bug hunt and main promotion run there (they need the local clone). To let her merge somewhere else, change review to merge (merging into main also needs allow_main true). Owner, 2026-10-31: Litha manages everything the owner works on. Owner, 2026-11-02: Metallic-Club/studio left out for now (Matt is rebuilding it).
